descriptive_qas.question: What is the blue ball on the floor doing during this segment, and how does it move relative to the white platform with the yellow ball on top?
choices: A) rolling steadily along the floor toward the central white platform that has another ball resting on top of it
B) sitting nearly still on the floor beside the platform while the yellow ball remains the only moving ball
C) rolling steadily away from the central white platform and out toward the right-side dominoes
D) bouncing up off the floor and striking the underside of the central white platform with the yellow ball on top

descriptive_qas.question: What happens as the blue floor ball reaches the right side of the white platform during this segment?
choices: A) the floor ball collides with the platform's outer edge and rebounds without touching any leg
B) the floor ball passes under the platform without contacting the platform at all
C) the floor ball runs into the platform's front-right corner at floor level, striking a supporting leg and stopping there as the platform begins to shift
D) the floor ball turns away before reaching the platform and rolls off toward the left-side dominoes

descriptive_qas.question: What is the white platform under the yellow ball doing during this segment?
choices: A) tipping over toward one side as it falls, while the ball that was resting on top rolls off the tilting surface
B) sliding straight across the floor without tipping, while the ball that was resting on top rides along with it
C) remaining mostly level and stationary, while the ball that was resting on top stays balanced in place
D) springing back upright after a slight wobble, while the ball that was resting on top bounces but does not roll off

descriptive_qas.question: Near the fallen platform, what are the nearby black dominoes doing during this segment, and what pattern do they follow?
choices: A) the nearest dominoes stay upright while the fallen platform slides past them, leaving the row unchanged
B) the closest domino is knocked over and falls into its neighbor, which then tips the next one, propagating a chain reaction along the row
C) several dominoes are struck at once by the platform and collapse together simultaneously rather than one after another
D) the closest domino is knocked backward away from the row, so the motion stops instead of spreading to the others

causal_qas.question: Why does the white platform start to tip after the blue ball rolls in from the right side underneath it?
choices: A) the floor ball transferred momentum into one of the platform's supporting legs, removing support from that side and destabilizing the platform above it
B) one of the dominoes far across the scene fell first and somehow disturbed the platform from a distance
C) the platform is scripted to fall on a fixed timer regardless of whether anything actually hits it
D) the yellow ball rolled across the top surface first, pushing the platform sideways and making the support legs slide apart

causal_qas.question: Why does the white platform tip down on the blue-ball/right side instead of the yellow-ball/left side?
choices: A) the supporting leg on this side was knocked out earlier, so the platform pivots over the legs that are still standing and falls toward the now-unsupported side under gravity
B) the blue ball becomes heavier than the yellow ball at that moment, so its extra weight pulls the platform down on the right side
C) the left supporting leg collapses first, so the platform rotates over the right legs and drops toward the yellow-ball side under gravity
D) a nearby domino strikes the top of the platform from the left, so the board is pushed over to the right even though both legs are still supporting it

causal_qas.question: Why are the black dominoes at the bottom of the scene falling one after another during this segment?
choices: A) the falling platform — and/or the ball that rolled off the top of it — struck the first domino, whose fall then knocked over its neighbor, propagating the impulse along the row
B) one of the far dominoes toppled backward on its own first, and the chain reaction then spread in the opposite direction toward the start of the row
C) the platform slid underneath the entire domino line and lifted their bases, causing the whole row to lose balance and fall without neighbor-to-neighbor contact
D) the blue ball rolled directly through the middle of the domino rows, hitting several dominoes at once and making them collapse together
